notes.title: Major technical update - new version!
notes.notes:
Good news, we have considered your feedback and comments and improved various features of the game.

    1st: improved graphics - with high quality lighting and shadows, 
    2nd: better gameplay balancing for the singleplayer campaign and missions, 
    3rd: more realism by using advanced blood effects and textures for injured hostiles and friendly units. 


Check out the new version and get ready for the fight!

notes.title: Update for Elite vs. Freedom!
notes.notes: We improved the third-person camera movement and behavior. Additionally, we added the ability to sprint (including stamina). We also changed the default controls: press "Shift" to sprint and press "Space" to jump. On the controller "Left Bumper" is now Sprint and "B Button" is Autocannon. The default controls, including mouse sensitivity can be customized by the users anytime in the "Settings" menu.
